title:
€687,000.00 in 45 days

a Google Ads and Meta Ads ecosystem
googleAdsShareLabel: Of the budget invested in Google Ads
contextText: An e-commerce business founded in 2021 to sell technology across Italy, with a catalogue later expanded and distribution extended to Europe and the United States.
situationText: When we came in, in 2024: falling revenue, high advertising spend and open technical issues on the website and connected systems.
goalText: Relaunch the store ahead of November and December, the months of peak demand, and maximise profit.
analysisText: Analysis of the existing strategy and its results; a new setup with lower investment and higher profit from the first month.
interventionText: Identifying and fixing issues across the website, applications and connected systems, with a series of technical improvements.
optimisationText: Periodic analyses across the related ecosystems reveal points of improvement to act and invest on, steadily boosting performance.
shopifyAlt: Shopify dashboard: €687,545.50 in total sales and 2,145 orders from 1 November to 16 December 2024
shopifyCaption: Total sales, orders, sessions and conversion rate for the period, compared with the previous six weeks.
googleAdsAlt: Google Ads overview from 1 November to 15 December 2024: 66,453 clicks, €3.93 cost per conversion, €0.28 average CPC, €18,300.59 cost
googleAdsCaption: The key platform behind the result: about 2/3 of the budget was invested here, with an average return of 81.5 times the spend.
roiText: every euro invested in advertising corresponds to €81.50 in revenue.
principleText: A return of this kind is only achievable when several ecosystems are managed under one roof, and with precision.
ctaTitle: Your advertising budget can return more.
ctaText: We analyse your advertising ecosystems and show you where the return can grow.
